test_title: PYST 18: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - English Language (Held On 30 Jun, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word from the following sentence.

Elegant

The table cloth on my brother’s study table was classic and splendid, yet my mother found it very awkward and odd.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Awkward'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given word is **'Elegant'.**
 
• **Elegant:** It means graceful and attractive in appearance or behavior. (आकर्षक)
 
 
• **Example:** *She looked very **elegant** in her new dress.*
 
 
 
• The correct antonym **'awkward'** means a situation or a person that is characterized by a lack of ease, grace, or social comfort. (अजीब)
 
 
• **Example:** *His **awkward **dance moves drew laughter from the crowd.*
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct antonym is **'awkward'.**

Therefore, the correct answer is **'Option 4'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Classic:** It refers to high quality, important, and having a value that will last. (उत्‍कृष्‍ट)

 
 
• Example: William Shakespeare's plays are considered **classic** works of literature.
 
 
 
• **Odd:** It refers to strange or unusual in the way mentioned. (विचित्र)
 
 
• Example: There was something **odd **about his story.
 
 
 
• **Splendid:** It refers to excellent, beautiful, and impressive. (उत्कृष्ट)
 
 
• Example: We had **splendid **food at a new restaurant.
